description: An exceptional opportunity awaits a dedicated Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential role is with a premier skilled nursing facility committed to providing outstanding patient care and fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff. We are seeking a visionary leader to guide operations and uphold the highest standards of quality.This full-time position offers a highly competitive salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000 per year, reflecting the importance of this leadership role. If you are an experienced LNHA looking to make a significant impact in a dynamic healthcare setting, we encourage you to explore this confidential opening. Join a team dedicated to excellence and community well-being.
requirements: Active Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Proven leadership experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 per year, based on experience.
